rules.condition: in each configuration of the run set, through the ports
rules.statement: Verification must cover reset values of every register and the access type of every register field as given in the register tables.

rules.condition: in each configuration of the run set
rules.statement: Verification must cover direct and masked writes of DATA_OUT and DATA_OE and their reads, and the per-pin register view.

rules.condition: in each configuration of the run set
rules.statement: Verification must cover DATA_IN with and without the input filter.

rules.condition: in each configuration of the run set
rules.statement: Verification must cover interrupt detection on rising edge, falling edge, high level and low level, with INTR_STATE, INTR_ENABLE and INTR_TEST.

rules.condition: in each configuration of the run set
rules.statement: Verification must cover strap sampling with HW_STRAPS_DATA_IN_VALID and HW_STRAPS_DATA_IN.

rules.condition: in each configuration of the run set
rules.statement: Verification must cover bus error responses (unmapped addresses, sub-word writes, instruction fetches, integrity errors) and the fatal_fault alert.
The per-pin registers of all 32 GPIOs must behave alike.
Verification may check every GPIO for the 32-bit registers and only a selection of GPIOs for per-pin registers.

rules.condition: when only a selection of GPIOs is checked for per-pin registers
rules.statement: The selection of GPIOs must include GPIO[0], GPIO[15], GPIO[16] and GPIO[31].
